segment.source: Renders the rules of moving between plans as questions and answers: upgrading mid-term, downgrading, what happens to data on cancellation, when a refund is due, how notice periods work. Use it for: the band under a tier row, a billing help page, the section a support team links to twice a day. Prefer 'Pricing FAQ' for the wider set of money questions, and 'Guarantee Band' when the promise is one sentence worth saying loudly.
